rows.en: ...Ace! It's too dangerous in your condition. Let's get you to the base!!
...Ace! It's too dangerous in your condition. Please, let's get you to the base!!
...Ace! It's too dangerous in your condition. Let's get you to the base!!
...Ace! It's too dangerous in your condition. Please, let's get you to the base!!
...Ace, it's dangerous in your condition. Let's go to the base.
...Ace, it's dangerous in your condition. Let's go to the base.
The base? He can be treated there!? Good, then I'll take on the job of carrying Ace.
The badly wounded Ace was carried to the base by Ultraman.
That's...!!
That's...!!
That's...!!
That's...!!
That's...!!
That's...!!
That's...!!
That's...!!
That's...!!
That's...!!
That's...!!
That's...!!
Ultraseven and Ultraman Jack have been crucified on the crosses!
Dad...!! And Jack too!!
...So it's you, Zero.
You made it all the way here... That's my son.
What're you doing...!! Getting yourself caught like that!!
To think I'd be saved by you once again...
Never mind that!! Let's get outta here, quick!!
Wait...! ...It's them!!
Heh heh heh heh.
This place will be your graveyard.
Where are you!? Where the hell are you hiding!!
Brother Seven!! And Brother Jack!
Seven! Jack!
Ultraseven! Ultraman Jack!
Ultraseven and Ultraman Jack!!
You're Seven and Jack, if I remember right! Hang on, I'll get you outta there!!
Ultraseven! And Ultraman Jack!
Ultraseven! And Ultraman Jack!
Ultraseven! Ultraman Jack!
Ultraseven! Ultraman Jack!
Seven and Jack...
Seven and Jack...
Heh heh heh heh.
This place will be your graveyard.
Huh? Who's there!?
We are the invincible Alien Guts, never once defeated in any battle.
We have already analyzed your ability data from your battles so far.
First, Ultraman Zero...
A young Ultra Warrior whose father is Seven. His main weapons are the two "Zero Sluggers".
Next, OOO...
A Kamen Rider powered by O Medals, he uses various combos to suit the situation.
00 is a Gundam equipped with two GN Drives.
The power generated by its "Twin Drive System" is immeasurable.
And then, Ultraman Mebius...
His special attack is the "Mebium Shoot". That heat ray could pierce any metal.
Furthermore, Kamen Rider W...
Oi! How long are you planning to keep this up?
By the power of the Earth's memories, the Gaia Memories...
Tch! Knock it off!! We're making the first move!!
Obtained the "Execution Ground Key (Right)".
Ultraman Zero and the others rescued Ultraseven and Ultraman Jack.
Dad!! Are you okay!?
It'll take more than this to bring me down.
Figures. That's my dad for ya!
But Zero... you did well to defeat a formidable foe like Alien Guts.
I didn't do it on my own. It's all thanks to my friends.
Heh... You've become someone I can rely on, Zero.
Cut it out, Dad... Right now, all of us have to bring our strength together as one.
Indeed... We intend to fight alongside you as well. But in the battle before Jack was crucified...
Wait, Brother Seven. A wound like this...
Jack! Don't push yourself! You've taken heavy damage.
Then you should get treated at the base. It's well equipped, so you'll be fine.
Very well, I'll carry Jack. Tell me where it is.
The badly wounded Ultraman Jack was carried to the base by Ultraseven.
Ultraseven joined the party!
{8074} and the others rescued Ultraseven and Ultraman Jack.
Brother Seven, Brother Jack, are you all right!?
Seven! Jack, are you okay!?
Seven, Jack! Are you both okay!?

notes.note: #0.136-0.141 continue the 11 leader variants begun at #0.131 (story_061). Same slot pattern as the 0357 blocks: #0.135 rough, #0.137/#0.139 polite (desu/masu) -> 'Please,'; #0.140-0.141 curt, no exclamation. Identical Japanese kept identical.
No speaker recovered; Ultraman by context (same line is labelled Ultraman at #0.96 in story_061, and #0.144 says Ultraman carried Ace). 'He' = Ace.
#0.1-0.12 twelve leader variants, all identical -> identical English.
Zero's 'oyaji' for Seven rendered 'Dad' throughout (#0.21, #0.73, #0.75, #0.79); no earlier English precedent found.
Speaker '???' = Alien Guts (named at #0.56). Laugh 'fu fu fu fu' as 'Heh heh heh heh.'; #0.46-0.47 repeat it identically (only a comma differs in #0.30 vs #0.47).
Labelled Ultraman, but the rough 'iyagaru' doesn't fit Ultraman's voice; likely Zero (this is Zero's branch). Text written speaker-neutral, label left to the extractor; please verify.
#0.35-0.45 eleven leader variants: #0.35 Mebius ('niisan' -> 'Brother', per 'Brother Hikari' precedent), #0.39 rough (Momotaros-type), #0.44-0.45 curt.
Alien Guts speaks as 'we' (wareware); kept plural. #0.56-0.68 is its ability rundown, interrupted by Ankh.
'Zero Slugger' and 'Twin Drive System' (#0.63) and 'O Medals' (#0.61) are not in the glossary; used the franchise English names. Quoted as in the source brackets.
Key item name not yet in a translated item table; rendered 'Execution Ground Key (Right)'. Check against ItemNameFormal when items are translated (the Left key appears in story_061 #0.82).
Seven's 'tanomoshiku natta na' = Zero has become dependable; not a request.
Jack's 'kore gurai no kizu...' trails off as in the source (he means he can still fight).
Non-Zero branch begins: {8074} = party leader. #0.90-0.92 leader variants continue into story_063 (#0.90 Mebius, polite).

report: 80/80 rows. Uncertain: #0357 0.31 labelled Ultraman but voiced like Zero; #0356 0.142 speaker inferred (Ultraman). Not in glossary: Zero Slugger, O Medals, Twin Drive System, Execution Ground Key (Right) item; 'Dad' for Zero's oyaji.
